name: Gavleborg County (Sweden)

colors.symbolism: the roundels on the white quarters

description: A banner of the county arms, quartered: white quarters strewn with blue roundels bearing red moose, and black quarters bearing yellow goats.
history: The flag is the heraldic banner of the arms of Gavleborg County, granted in 1937 and combining the historic arms of the provinces of Gastrikland and Halsingland that make up the county.

features.role: arms of Gavleborg: Gastrikland moose and Halsingland goats
